name: Hermes Studio (backend + frontend)
install: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y python3.12-venv && cd backend && python3 -m venv .venv && ./.venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && ./.venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt && cd ../frontend && npm install

terminals.name: backend
terminals.command: cd backend && HERMES_MOCK=1 HERMES_HOME=/tmp/hermes CORS_ORIGINS="*" PORT=8000 ./.venv/bin/python -m web_gateway.entry
terminals.description: Hermes FastAPI web gateway (mock mode) on http://localhost:8000 — REST endpoints + /ws JSON-RPC WebSocket.

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.description: Static Hermes Studio dashboard served on http://localhost:3000 (connects to backend at :8000).
